fragments.text: The bid price will almost always be lower than the ask or “offer,” price. The difference between the bid price and the ask price is called the "spread."

fragments.section_anchor: Corporate debt market valuations remained near their historical averages
fragments.text: Yields on corporate bonds fell since the November report and by more than yields on comparable-maturity Treasury securities. Consequently, corporate bond spreads, measured as the difference in yields between corporate bonds and comparable-maturity Treasury securities, were moderately lower since November and near their historical average levels.
